content: पार्श्विकः {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [पार्श्वे भवः ठक्] Belonging to the side. .{@-कः@} .²1 A sides-man, partisan. .²2 A companion, an associate. .²3 A juggler. .²4 One who seeks money by fraudulent means, a thief. .²5 One who earns money through the instrumentality of oneʼs own kinsmen after knowing their needs by means of staying by the side (पार्श्व) of the king; <ls>Dānasāgara, Bibliotheca Indica 274, Fasc. 1, p. 41</ls>.
